auxiliary_input_hash_measurement: Kernel, full DT, initramfs, symbols, partial command DB and QEMU were all SHA256-checked before launch. QEMU was additionally rehashed after the diagnostic and remained unchanged.

npu_source.scope: Public source-correlated register interpretation; this does not establish that the production Image was built from that exact public tree.

sleep_counter_dt.frequency_scope: Declared by the actual supplied DT; not a physical oscillator measurement. This differs from the board's existing 32000-Hz chip_sleep_clk.

boot_stats_source.source_correlation: The pinned driver reads the declared clock frequency and one read32 at the counter base after four IMEM values. This run actually logged the MPM timestamp and 32768-Hz frequency and continued into the NoC bus driver. The four bootloader KPI values stayed zero; no bootloader execution or firmware handoff values were invented.

noc_source_contract.selection_basis: CONFIG_QCOM_BUS_CONFIG_RPMH=y was read from the exact production Image's embedded IKCONFIG; the pinned public Makefile selects this driver.
noc_source_contract.component_scope_note: The component receipt correctly keeps native_kernel_probe_observed=false; the separate real production-driver observation is recorded in this native receipt.

smmuv500_source_contract.skip_init_scope: The source skips some stream/context-bank reset initialization, not the TCU VERSION read, sACR or all subsequent global operations.

userspace_fixture_limits: The current UFS fixture has no attached LU in this diagnostic and no explicit console parameter. Marker absence alone cannot establish execution failure. Here the actual PID1 kernel panic, not marker absence, establishes failure before native userspace acceptance.
scope: Unchanged existing production Image and full captured live DT with explicit reference profiles; not an authenticated factory-image claim

observer.extension: Retains prior observations unchanged and adds 455 pure qom-get calls plus two query-status calls for CPUFreq. No device MMIO, QOM writes, guest-memory writes or guest execution by this added observer.
observer.diagnostic_modification: Adds invalid_mem to the QEMU log mask only

diagnostic_exit_code_note: Collector completed; this is not a guest boot or shutdown success code.

smem_probe.scope: Stopped guest SMEM driver publication and reference layout

aop_peer.scope: Stopped reference AOP peer state and supported-command consumption
aop_peer.reason: Connected reference peer consumed a supported command; IPCC notifications exist and no completion notification is pending

noc_qos_observer.scope: Stopped raw NoC QoS QOM observations; source-correlated DT comparisons
noc_qos_observer.interpretation: Raw configuration only. A matching nonzero word demonstrates stored guest programming; it does not establish traffic, bandwidth enforcement, SBM, power readiness or full boot. Deferred IPA need not match its eventual DT policy.

smmuv500_observer.scope: Stopped raw apps SMMUv500 QOM observation only
smmuv500_observer.interpretation: Reference model identity and raw device state only. Zero requests do not prove a native TBU probe or DMA test; native progress requires separate kernel-log evidence. Version and delays are declared reference assumptions, and firmware stream/context handoff remains unknown.

tsens24xx_observer.scope: Stopped raw TSENS24xx QOM state and explicit reference inputs
tsens24xx_observer.interpretation: Sampling counters, captured inputs, VALID and vendor TRDY are raw digital-reference observations. The boot mask, 25 C environment and 1 ms period are explicit model choices, not measured tablet state or analog calibration. DT thermal references establish consumer channels only; kernel logs independently establish native probe progress. IRQ metadata records DT wiring, not a native interrupt-delivery test.

cpufreq_hw_observer.scope: Stopped CPUFreq EPSS reference identity and raw QOM state
cpufreq_hw_observer.interpretation: This is a stopped raw QOM snapshot, not a CPUFreq probe, policy, userspace, frequency-transition or interrupt-delivery verdict. The four all-XO LUT states, voltage words, limit input, always-clocked per-core counters and edge-latched IRQ are declared reference policies, not measured tablet firmware or analog behavior. A single counter value does not prove progress, and a nonzero requested index does not identify its writer. The alternate GPLL0 input is reported but no row in this profile uses src=0. DT SPI/INTID fields describe wiring only. Native kernel progress must be assessed separately from printk and explicit userspace evidence.
